name: Platform Deploy
on:
  workflow_dispatch: null
permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read
  checks: read
  pull-requests: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ inputs.decommission_plan_only && format('platform-production-decommission-plan-{0}', github.ref) || 'platform-registry-mutation' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  decommission-live-plan:
    name: App Platform Decommission Live Plans
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.decommission_plan_only == true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'preview' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Reduced secret references
        env:
          DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          SPACES_ACCESS_ID: ${{ secrets.SPACES_ACCESS_ID }}
          SPACES_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPACES_SECRET_KEY }}
        run: "true"
  resolve-release:
    name: Resolve Release
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.decommission_plan_only != true
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      - name: Reduced secret references
        env: {}
        run: "true"
  deployment-contract-preflight:
    name: Preflight Deployment Contract (${{ matrix.environment }})
    if: needs.resolve-release.outputs.deployment_required == 'true'
    needs: resolve-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: ${{ matrix.environment }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - environment: staging
            argo_rollouts_variable: STAGING_ARGO_ROLLOUTS_ENABLED
          - environment: production
            argo_rollouts_variable: PRODUCTION_ARGO_ROLLOUTS_ENABLED
    steps:
      - name: Reduced secret references
        env: {}
        run: "true"
  build-image:
    name: Build Release Image
    if: needs.resolve-release.outputs.deployment_required == 'true'
    needs:
      - resolve-release
      - deployment-contract-preflight
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - name: Reduced secret references
        env:
          DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
        run: "true"
  reconcile-managed-postgres-ca-staging:
    name: Reconcile Managed Postgres CA (staging)
    if: needs.resolve-release.outputs.deployment_required != 'true'
    needs: resolve-release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    permissions:
      contents: read
    concurrency:
      group: platform-deploy-staging
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - name: Reduced secret references
        env:
          DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
          SPACES_ACCESS_ID: ${{ secrets.SPACES_ACCESS_ID }}
          SPACES_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.SPACES_SECRET_KEY }}
        run: "true"
  reconcile-managed-postgres-ca-production:
    name: Reconcile Managed Postgres CA (production)
    if: |
      needs.resolve-release.outputs.deployment_required != 'true' && needs['reconcile-managed-postgres-ca-staging'].result == 'success'
    needs:
      - resolve-release
      - reconcile-managed-postgres-ca-staging
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production
    permissions:
      contents: read
    concurrency:
      group: platform-deploy-production
      cancel-in-progress: false
    steps:
      - name: Reduced secret references

    name: Dispatch Ephemeral Verification
    if: |
      always() && needs.deploy-production.result == 'success' && vars.PLATFORM_EPHEMERAL_VERIFICATION_ENABLED == 'true'
    needs: deploy-production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

  notify-production-deploy-incident:
    name: Notify Production Deploy Incident
    if: |
      always() && (
        contains(fromJSON('["failure", "cancelled"]'), needs.resolve-release.result) ||
        contains(fromJSON('["failure", "cancelled"]'), needs.deployment-contract-preflight.result) ||
        contains(fromJSON('["failure", "cancelled"]'), needs.build-image.result) ||
        contains(fromJSON('["failure", "cancelled"]'), needs.deploy-staging.result) ||
        contains(fromJSON('["failure", "cancelled"]'), needs.deploy-production.result) ||
        contains(fromJSON('["failure", "cancelled"]'), needs.record-staging-release-health.result) ||
        (
          needs.resolve-release.result == 'success' &&
          needs.build-image.result == 'success' &&
          needs.deploy-staging.result == 'success' &&
          needs.deploy-production.result == 'skipped' &&
          needs.deploy-staging.outputs.applied != 'true'
        )
      )
    needs:
      - resolve-release
      - deployment-contract-preflight
      - build-image
      - deploy-staging
      - deploy-production

        run: "true"
